name: tpl-existence-1-goal~p2
task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The three hard clauses correctly capture “grab the key first, then make your way to the goal”. Existence(has_key) is required (the precedence does not itself force the key), Existence(at_goal) enforces reaching the goal, and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) enforces the ordering. The compiled machine reflects these requirements.

texts: The agent must eventually have the key.
The agent must eventually reach the goal.
Reaching the goal must occur after having the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
